description: Recreate a reference video (a link or file) as the user's own film with OpenMotion: rebuild it as an editable OpenMotion project and hand it over open in the editor, keeping the original content or swapping in the user's copy, brand and assets. This includes small edits to the user's own finished video when no editable project for it exists. "Make one like this" and "I want this feel" both count as recreation. In a workspace with the user's product material, a bare link alone means "make one like this for us". References that also contain portraits, product photography, live-action or AI footage, narration or music are in scope: those parts use configured media generation while the structure stays editable. Not for only analysing or discussing a video. Use openmotion-director when the reference is only inspiration for an original film, openmotion-template-to-video for an existing template, openmotion-production for edits to an existing editable OpenMotion project, and openmotion-video-to-template for a reusable template package.
